messages:
alex (DevEx): quick flag: onboarding sample app failed during a key rotation. customer rotated project key and got 403s. repro below.
priya (SDK): ugh. do they have both REDWOOD_API_KEY and REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY set?
alex (DevEx): yes. container env: REDWOOD_PROJECT=team-aurora, REDWOOD_API_KEY=org_old, REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY=proj_new. we updated project key in k8s but image still had REDWOOD_API_KEY. outgoing header was org_old -> 403.
noah (Infra): server logs show generic 403 "permission denied". we can return structured error for scope issues: {code: "auth_scope_mismatch", detail: "token not valid for project team-aurora"} and add header x-redwood-scope: project.
priya (SDK): that plus client-side detection would let SDK surface a clear message during onboarding. also found SDK env resolution favors API key if present (API_KEY > PROJECT_KEY). that's backwards when REDWOOD_PROJECT is configured.
ellis (Support): customers rotate proj keys and get bitten because docs don't spell out precedence. requests should prefer project key when REDWOOD_PROJECT is set.
priya (SDK): plan: 1) change precedence to: if REDWOOD_PROJECT set -> PROJECT_KEY > API_KEY else API_KEY. 2) emit one-time startup warn if both keys present. 3) add `redwood doctor --auth` lint. 4) do not auto-retry on 401/403 auth failures (only 429/5xx).
alex (DevEx): please add a tiny quickstart note and a rotation checklist snippet. support gets a lot of these tickets.
noah (Infra): infra will implement structured error + header and expose a metric auth.scope_mismatch for onboarding telemetry.
priya (SDK): opened PR internal/pull/411 - flips precedence, adds warning, doctor check, and adjusts retry policy. added tests for env matrix.
ci-bot: ci: running tests for branch fix/auth-precedence... all green
priya (SDK): cut release sdk-js v0.12.0 with changelog: "Respect REDWOOD_PROJECT when resolving credentials; warn when both org and project keys are present; avoid retrying on auth failures; improved error guidance for rotations."
ellis (Support): validated sample app in staging. rotation now succeeds when swapping project key without falling back to org key. updating onboarding doc and closing out.
